links.outcome: Readability scores of LLM responses to cataract queries versus human responses
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o had lowest readability score (26.02 ± 10.78), highest reading difficulty. Copilot scored 40.26 ± 14.58, still lower than humans (51.54 ± 13.71).
links.quote: While Copilot recorded a higher readability score (40.26 ± 14.58) than the other LLMs, it still remained lower than that of humans (51.54 ± 13.71).

screen.reason: Evaluates five commercial LLMs answering cataract-related queries against human responses across multiple metrics, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
